note: 用户在 2026-10-03 看过 7 站草稿后表示认可（「我喜欢，你继续」），属于整体认可、未逐条修改；用户随时可以改动或撤回任一条。my_take 只写来自用户回答的个人表述；suggestion 是 AI 提出的建议，不代表用户已经在做。七站顺序是作品的叙事安排，不是荣格的理论次序。source 的卷号与段号已于 2026-10-03 对照《荣格全集》（Hull 英译）扫描件的段号标记逐条核对：人格面具、投射、情结、阴影、阿尼玛与阿尼姆斯、自性六站的 source_verified 为 true；「他者的凝视」是叙事主题而非荣格术语，没有原书出处，保持 false 且页面标为叙事主题。核对依据的是扫描件的段号，不是纸书印刷页码。 emotions 为 2026-10-03 新增的情绪节点草稿，用户尚未确认（emotions_confirmed 为 false）；未确认时只有本机预览显示。 2026-10-05 起每站带英文字段（*_en），译文与作品集手册的英文版一致，由 Claude 翻译；英文页以 ?lang=en 打开星图。

stations.jung_concept: Persona 指一个人在社会中呈现给他人的角色与形象，是集体心理的一部分，被体验为属于自己；它帮助人适应环境，但也可能被误当成全部的自己。
stations.source: 荣格《自我与无意识的关系》，CW 7, §§243–247（核心定义 §245；另见 §305）
stations.my_take: 我很在意自己呈现出的样子：外貌、能力与自律。
stations.suggestion: 可选尝试：把「我想呈现的样子」和「我实际需要的东西」分开写下来看看。
stations.motion: 一排面具缓慢并立，镜头穿过时轻微偏移。
stations.confirmed_note: 用户 2026-10-03 整体认可草稿，未逐条修改
stations.jung_concept_en: The persona is the role and image a person presents to others. It is part of the collective psyche, yet is experienced as one’s own. It helps us adapt to our surroundings, but can be mistaken for the whole self.
stations.source_en: Jung, “The Relations between the Ego and the Unconscious”, CW 7, §§243–247 (core definition §245; see also §305)
stations.my_take_en: I care a great deal about how I come across: appearance, ability and self-discipline.
stations.suggestion_en: Something to try: write down separately “the self I want to present” and “what I actually need”.

stations.jung_concept: 这一站是作品的叙事主题，不是荣格的专门术语。它借用的意思是：自我形象的形成离不开他人的目光与回应。「凝视」一词在思想史上更常与萨特、拉康相关。
stations.source: 叙事主题；灵感来自参考短片中的「他者」一词，与萨特、拉康的「凝视」概念相近，非荣格术语
stations.my_take: 我希望被认真看见，也希望在重要的关系里是特别的。
stations.suggestion: 可选尝试：把「被认真对待」和「事事被优先」分开，直接说出自己的需要。
stations.motion: 巨眼随镜头转动，视线始终对着观者。
stations.confirmed_note: 用户 2026-10-03 整体认可草稿，未逐条修改
stations.jung_concept_en: This station is the work’s narrative theme, not a technical term of Jung’s. It borrows one idea: the image we form of ourselves cannot be separated from the gaze and the responses of others. In the history of ideas, “the gaze” is more often associated with Sartre and Lacan.
stations.source_en: A narrative theme with no source in Jung’s writings; close to Sartre’s and Lacan’s idea of “the gaze”.
stations.my_take_en: I want to be seen seriously, and to be someone special in the relationships that matter.
stations.suggestion_en: Something to try: separate “being treated seriously” from “always coming first”, and say what you need directly.

stations.jung_concept: 投射是一种无意识的自动过程：个体自己的无意识内容被体验为外部对象或他人的属性，因而被「看」在别人身上。内容可以是不愿承认的特质，也可以是尚未意识到的渴望。
stations.source: 荣格《心理类型》，CW 6, §783（定义章）；《埃翁》，CW 9ii, §17（另见 §16）
stations.my_take: 我会羡慕别人，也会反感别人，这些反应值得我留意。
stations.suggestion: 可选尝试：遇到强烈的羡慕或反感时，先问自己：这在说我的什么需要？
stations.motion: 粒子被另一团粒子缓慢吸走。
stations.confirmed_note: 用户 2026-10-03 整体认可草稿，未逐条修改
stations.jung_concept_en: Projection is an unconscious, automatic process: a person’s own unconscious contents are experienced as properties of an outside object or another person, and so are “seen” in others. The content may be a trait one refuses to admit, or a longing not yet noticed.
stations.source_en: Jung, Psychological Types, CW 6, §783 (the definitions chapter); Aion, CW 9ii, §17 (see also §16)
stations.my_take_en: I envy others, and I am put off by others; these reactions deserve my attention.
stations.suggestion_en: Something to try: when envy or aversion is strong, first ask: what need of mine is this speaking about?

stations.jung_concept: 情结是围绕某种强烈情绪聚集的一组观念与意象，带有相对的自主性，被触动时会比平时更快、更强地接管反应。
stations.source: 荣格《情结理论综述》，CW 8, §§200–201（情结的定义见 §201；「情结可以拥有我们」见 §200）
stations.my_take: 有些时刻我会强烈感到被忽视、被不公平对待、没有选择权，或付出没有回应。
stations.suggestion: 可选尝试：感到情绪变强时先暂停、离开现场，平静后再沟通。
stations.motion: 粒子被拉紧，随后向四周崩开。
stations.confirmed_note: 用户 2026-10-03 整体认可草稿，未逐条修改
stations.jung_concept_en: A complex is a cluster of ideas and images gathered around a strong emotion. It has a relative autonomy, and when touched it takes over the response faster and more strongly than usual.
stations.source_en: Jung, “A Review of the Complex Theory”, CW 8, §§200–201 (the definition is at §201; “complexes can have us” is at §200)
stations.my_take_en: There are moments when I feel strongly ignored, treated unfairly, without a choice, or that my effort gets no response.
stations.suggestion_en: Something to try: when the emotion grows strong, pause and step away; talk again once calm.

stations.jung_concept: 阴影是个体不愿承认、被压抑或尚未发展的那部分人格，不只包含令人不安的特质，也可能包含未被使用的力量。
stations.source: 荣格《埃翁》，CW 9ii, §§13–16（核心 §14）；《原型与集体无意识》，CW 9i, §45
stations.my_take: 我身上有我想改变的部分，我不想假装它不存在。
stations.suggestion: 可选尝试：把「我做过需要改变的事」和「我整个人没有成长」分开看。
stations.motion: 一团影子从人形边缘慢慢展开。
stations.confirmed_note: 用户 2026-10-03 整体认可草稿，未逐条修改
stations.jung_concept_en: The shadow is the part of the personality a person will not admit, has repressed, or has not yet developed. It holds not only unsettling traits but also unused strengths.
stations.source_en: Jung, Aion, CW 9ii, §§13–16 (core: §14); “The Archetypes and the Collective Unconscious”, CW 9i, §45
stations.my_take_en: There are parts of me I want to change, and I do not want to pretend they are not there.
stations.suggestion_en: Something to try: tell apart “I did something that needs to change” from “I as a whole person have not grown”.

stations.jung_concept: 阿尼玛指男性心理中的内在女性形象，阿尼姆斯指女性心理中的内在男性形象，二者是意识与无意识之间的中介，常经由对异性的投射被体验。
stations.source: 荣格《原型与集体无意识》，CW 9i, §66（阿尼玛是生命本身的原型）；《埃翁》，CW 9ii, §§28–29（阿尼姆斯）
stations.my_take: 亲密关系对我很重要，我希望在其中被认真对待。
stations.suggestion: 可选尝试：分清我对关系的期待，哪些来自对方这个人，哪些来自我心里的形象。
stations.motion: 两团粒子互相靠近，又保持一点距离。
stations.confirmed_note: 用户 2026-10-03 整体认可草稿，未逐条修改
stations.jung_concept_en: The anima is the inner feminine figure in a man’s psyche, the animus the inner masculine figure in a woman’s. They mediate between the conscious and the unconscious, and are often experienced through projection onto the other sex.
stations.source_en: Jung, “The Archetypes and the Collective Unconscious”, CW 9i, §66 (the anima as the archetype of life itself); Aion, CW 9ii, §§28–29 (the animus)
stations.my_take_en: Intimate relationships matter to me; I hope to be taken seriously in them.
stations.suggestion_en: Something to try: tell apart which of my expectations of a relationship come from the person in front of me, and which from the image in my own mind.

stations.jung_concept: 自性是心理的统摄性中心，是整体性的原型，涵盖意识与无意识的总和；它是个体化的目标，但这一过程贯穿一生，难以完全完成。
stations.my_take: 我也有不需要证明什么的舒服时刻：雨声、昏暗的灯、音乐，以及作品完成时的满足。
stations.suggestion: 可选尝试：给这些舒服的时刻留出固定的位置，让生活不只在追赶目标。
stations.motion: 所有粒子收束成转身的人形，面向观者。
stations.confirmed_note: 用户 2026-10-03 整体认可草稿，未逐条修改
stations.jung_concept_en: The self is the psyche’s overarching centre and the archetype of wholeness, embracing the sum of conscious and unconscious. It is the goal of individuation, a process that runs through a whole life and can hardly be completed.
stations.my_take_en: I also have moments of ease where I have nothing to prove: rain, a dim lamp, music, and the satisfaction of a finished piece.
stations.suggestion_en: Something to try: give those moments of ease a fixed place, so that life is not only a chase after goals.
